name: cx-goal-one-rule~p3
task: Open the door, then take the box from the other room; try not to drop the key while the door is still closed.

value.feedback: NO CHANGES NEEDED: The clauses capture the task: hard Existence(door_open) for opening the door, hard Existence(target_picked_up) for taking the box, and the hard RespondedExistence expresses that picking up the box is required once the door is open; the soft Precedence(door_open, key_lost) matches the preference 'try not to drop the key while the door is still closed'.

texts: Eventually, the door must be open.
If the door is ever open, then the target box must be picked up at some point.
At some point, the target box must be picked up.
It is preferred that the key is never lost before the door is opened.
